Lewis, E., McNaul, S., Jamieson, M., Henriksen, M.S., Matthews, H.S., White, J., Walsh, L., Grove, J., Shultz, T., Skone, T.J. and Stevens, R. (2022). Comparison of Commercial, State-of-the-Art, Fossil-Based Hydrogen Production Technologies. DOE/NETL-2022/3241. U.S. Department of Energy, National Energy Technology Laboratory, April 12, 2022.

Targeted pass over the executive summary, Chapters 3-5 summary exhibits and the per-case performance, air emission, carbon balance, total plant cost and O&M exhibits. Loaded (main file): the six cases (Case 1 SMR without capture, Case 2 SMR with capture, Case 3 ATR with capture, Case 4 Shell coal gasification without capture, Case 5 with capture, Case 6 coal/biomass co-gasification with capture): capacity, capacity factor, HHV and LHV cold-gas and effective thermal efficiency, net-power and feed-energy rows derived from printed kWt, kg/hr and MWe, stack CO2, captured CO2 (derived from the printed carbon in the CO2 product), TPC and TOC per kg H2/day, absolute TOC, fixed and variable O&M (excluding fuel), LCOH with and without CO2 T&S. Also loaded as separate capture sub-systems: TPC of the Cansolv amine, MDEA and two-stage Selexol units and of CO2 compression and drying (account lines of the TPC exhibits; no energy or opex split is printed for them). Not loaded: water, SO2/NOx/PM/Hg, equipment lists, stream tables, sensitivity analyses (Sect. 5.4), the R&D chapter, Appendix A-B life-cycle detail beyond the case totals (in other-values). Locator convention: printed page numbers (not PDF pages; PDF page = printed page + 18). Traps: (1) all costs are 2018 US dollars (December 2018 cost base); per-capacity costs are per kg H2/day of plant size, not per annual kg; capacity factors 90% (reforming) and 80% (gasification) apply to O&M and to annual quantities. (2) Costs are NOAK for the non-capture cases only; the report says capture cases may understate first-of-a-kind costs. (3) HHV throughout (the report also gives LHV efficiencies). Cold gas efficiency is hydrogen HHV over fuel HHV; effective thermal efficiency adds net power. (4) Exhibit 4-50 (Case 5) prints $0.03493/kg for the total variable O&M (typo; value derived from the annual total). (5) Case 6 capture is 92.7% in ES-2 and the Case 6 performance exhibit but 92.6% in Exhibit ES-1. (6) Fixed-cost and capacity-factor inputs differ between reforming and gasification, so cross-technology capex per annual output differs from the per-capacity figures. (7) Plant cost with capture is not split between host and capture units in the summary; the host rows carry INCLUDES CAPTURE and the capture sub-systems are given separately as TPC account lines, so adding the two would double count. (8) Case 1 hydrogen compression to 925 psig is inside every plant cost; excess SMR steam is exported at no value. (9) CO2 product carbon is converted to CO2 with 44.01/12.011.
